name: link-extractor-9000
description: A Firefox-first browser extension for collecting URLs across pages.

scripts.check: node --check src/lib/search-adapters.js && node --check src/lib/collection.js && node --check src/content/extract-links.js && node --check src/popup/popup.js && node -e "for (const f of ['firefox/manifest.json','chromium/manifest.json']) JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))" && node scripts/verify-logo.mjs && node scripts/verify-contrast.mjs
scripts.verify:firefox: node scripts/package.mjs firefox && node scripts/verify-firefox.mjs run
scripts.verify:chrome: node scripts/package.mjs chromium && node scripts/verify-chrome.mjs run
